fields.sourceTitle: Exact CC18 title preserved without rewriting.
fields.originalTitleJa: Authoritative Japanese title when a verifiable source provides it; null when unavailable.
fields.translatedTitleZhTw: Faithful Traditional Chinese translation of originalTitleJa; null when the original title is unavailable.
fields.title: Traditional Chinese reader-facing H1 grounded in source signals and editorial judgment.
fields.seoTitle: Traditional Chinese search title containing the catalog number, performer when known, review intent and strongest source-grounded terms.
fields.socialTitle: Short hook for Open Graph and short-video surfaces; it may be more conversational but cannot add unsupported facts.
fields.titleSignals: Two to four short, source-grounded entities or concepts used to construct and audit all generated titles.
fields.titleVersion: Positive integer incremented when the title strategy or generated title set is materially revised.
